title: Beautiful Shadows
concept: Ode Clay Studio: a light stone-and-white shop page for a Porto ceramics studio where one Beautiful lg plinth holds a hand-drawn moon jar, Beautiful md popovers and piece cards sit around it, and Beautiful sm carries every pill, input and button.
notes: The three presets are used verbatim as Tailwind arbitrary shadows, neutral and never stacked; the only elevation change is piece cards lifting md → lg on hover/focus. Vessels are inline SVG drawn from lathe profiles (no images). Glaze chips are native radios that re-glaze the hero jar. Reduced motion drops the entrance, ping, kiln bar and counter.
